content: Glass morphism design pitfalls: (1) Too little blur (<5px sigma) looks broken not frosted, (2) Too high opacity (0.8+) kills translucency, (3) Missing subtle border removes realism, (4) No visual content behind defeats purpose, (5) Poor text readability on dynamic backgrounds, (6) Overuse creates visual noise, (7) Forgetting performance cost of backdrop-filter. For player UIs: glass needs to blend with dynamic video backgrounds which change constantly, making static color tokens insufficient.
